title: Add KRVOTOK supplemental visual to Developer/Create reflection
body:
## Summary

- Registers the supplied `ČOVEČANSTVO — KRVOTOK / ZDRAVA KRV / BOLJI ŽIVOT` asset as a new `supplementalVisualReference` in the existing Developer/Create → VRH → Radni Takt reflection flow.
- Keeps the contract bounded: no new module, route, source-of-truth, medical runtime, diagnostic logic, or ownership drift.
- Updates docs and regression coverage so EXTREM authors the visual metadata, EXTRONDOL carries it as governance evidence, and SPAJA KOD exposes only audit-safe summary data.
- Added metadata follows the existing shape:

```ts
{
  canonicalNarrativeId: 'covecanstvo-krvotok-zdrava-krv-bolji-zivot-developer-create',
  scenarioId: 'covecanstvo-krvotok-zdrava-krv-bolji-zivot-developer-create',
  auditRole: 'additive-audit-reference-only'
}
```

## Linked Issue / Change Driver

- Issue / ticket / rationale: User-requested integration of the supplied KRVOTOK visual into the locked `DEVELOPER AND CREATE == VRH PROGRAMSKOG EKVILADENTA == RADNI TAKT MOZGA` reflection package as documentation/evidence-only metadata.
